import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top products by revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
axes[0, 0].barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by customer age group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(age_sales_ordered))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_sales_ordered.values, labels=age_sales_ordered.index, 
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Payment method usage over time
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
df['day_of_week'] = df['date'].dt.day_name()
payment_by_day = df.groupby(['day_of_week', 'payment_method']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
day_order = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
payment_by_day_ordered = payment_by_day.reindex([x for x in day_order if x in payment_by_day.index])
payment_by_day_ordered.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 0], 
                             color=['#D2691E', '#8B4513', '#A0522D'])
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Day of Week', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Payment Method Usage by Day of Week', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Payment Method', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(axes[1, 0].get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average transaction value by product size and takeaway status
size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().reset_index()
size_takeaway['is_takeaway'] = size_takeaway['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_takeaway['size'] = pd.Categorical(size_takeaway['size'], categories=size_order, ordered=True)
size_takeaway = size_takeaway.sort_values('size')
pivot_data = size_takeaway.pivot(index='size', columns='is_takeaway', values='total')
x = np.arange(len(pivot_data.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = axes[1, 1].bar(x - width/2, pivot_data['Dine-in'], width, label='Dine-in', color='#CD853F')
bars2 = axes[1, 1].bar(x + width/2, pivot_data['Takeaway'], width, label='Takeaway', color='#8B4513')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product Size', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Size and Service Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(pivot_data.index)
axes[1, 1].legend(fontsize=9)
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        axes[1, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                       f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
